<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market rally:</strong> The Sensex climbed 776 points as a slump in crude oil prices improved the domestic economic outlook and triggered a broad-based market recovery.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Wealth creation:</strong> Indian equity markets rebounded after a five-day decline, resulting in a surge of Rs 5.10 lakh crore in total investor wealth.</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
